title: Coding Strand vs Template Strand
text: The coding strand has the same sequence as mRNA (except T instead of U). The DNA coding strand 5'-ATG-3' corresponds to mRNA 5'-AUG-3'.

title: Locating the Mutation
text: In ATGCCTTACGAA, the codons are ATG-CCT-TAC-GAA. The C in CCT changes to T, making CTT. In mRNA terms: CCU becomes CUU.
